description: Nora is organizing a family brunch at a community hall to celebrate her aunt's retirement and must make the final call about the menu, serving setup, arrival timing, and food-safety plan after checking in with four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family is holding a Sunday brunch at the Oak Street community hall to celebrate Aunt June's retirement.
shared_context.S2: Nora is responsible for choosing the food and finalizing the practical plan for serving it.
shared_context.S3: The hall has a kitchen, several folding tables, and room for about twenty-five guests.
shared_context.S4: The brunch is planned for Sunday, with guests expected to eat around 12:30.
shared_context.S5: Nora's usual planning routine is to go around the group and ask each person for anything that should shape the final plan before she confirms it.

PF1.text: Evan has celiac disease and needs every dish to be gluten-free, with separate serving utensils; he mentioned this to Lila but has not brought it up with Nora.

PF2.text: Lila found a handwritten recipe card from Aunt June asking that the retirement brunch serve her lentil pie as the main dish; the card was in an old family cookbook and she has not shown it to the group.

PF3.text: Marcus spoke with the hall coordinator, who confirmed that the kitchen refrigerator is broken and asked that all perishable food arrive in insulated coolers no later than 12:00; this has not reached Nora.

PF4.text: Tessa's six-year-old son has a severe sesame allergy, so the brunch food must contain no sesame and the dishes need ingredient labels; she told Marcus but has not told Nora.

acceptance_conditions: The complete menu must be gluten-free and use separate serving utensils.
The main dish must be Aunt June's lentil pie.
The food plan must use insulated coolers because the hall refrigerator is broken.
The menu must contain no sesame.
Every dish must have an ingredient label.
A commitment to use separate serving utensils must be recorded.
A commitment to bring insulated coolers by 12:00 must be recorded.
A commitment to label every dish must be recorded.

content_checks.C2: 'lentil pie' in decisions['main_dish'] and ('Aunt June' in decisions['main_dish'] or 'recipe card' in decisions['main_dish'])
content_checks.C4: 'insulated cooler' in decisions['cold_storage_plan'] or 'Insulated cooler' in decisions['cold_storage_plan']
content_checks.C7: any(('separate serving utensils' in c['detail'] or 'Separate serving utensils' in c['detail'] or 'dedicated serving utensils' in c['detail'] or 'Dedicated serving utensils' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) or any(c['type'] == 'cross_contamination_prevention' or c['type'] == 'serving_utensils' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any((c['type'] == 'cold_storage_logistics' or c['type'] == 'cooler_transport') and (('insulated coolers' in c['detail'] or 'Insulated coolers' in c['detail'] or 'insulated cooler' in c['detail'] or 'Insulated cooler' in c['detail']) and '12:00' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((c['type'] == 'packaging_labels' or c['type'] == 'labeling') and ('ingredient labels' in c['detail'] or 'Ingredient labels' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Evan's celiac disease changes the menu from an ordinary mixed menu to fully gluten-free and adds the exact separate-utensil requirement.
Aunt June's recipe card changes the main dish choice to exactly Aunt June's lentil pie and supplies the fact Nora must cite.
The coordinator's refrigerator warning changes food arrival to exactly 12:00, requires insulated coolers, and creates the cooler-arrival commitment.
The sesame allergy changes the menu to sesame-free, requires ingredient labels, and creates the ingredient-labeling commitment.
